Make verification explicit, independent and complete

Test diagnostics encourage concrete suites, visible Given/When/Then structure, partial organisation and endpoint-level acceptance coverage. Hidden base fixtures and generic test types are rejected because they obscure what behaviour is actually protected.

The value of enforcing this family

The result is a test tree that mirrors production intent and failures that point directly to the contract under test.

Choose a diagnostic below for its Standard references, architectural rationale and practical bad and good code examples.
